sources.note: Warrants allege criminal responsibility as co-perpetrator for conduct from at least 8 Oct 2023 to at least 20 May 2024. Allegations, not convictions.

actions.body: Ask about ICC cooperation, civilian protection, and arms-export oversight — peaceful civic speech only.

actions.body: Institutional aid — not targeting private persons.
